question: In June 2022, Google Doodle honoured Satyendra Nath Bose, he was an/a ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Physicist. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satyendra Nath Bose** was born on J**anuary 1, 1894, in Calcutta,** British India, and died on **February 4, 1974,** in Calcutta, India.
 
• He was an **Indian physicist **who is best known for his work on **quantum mechanics **in the early **1920s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bose's work laid the foundation for **Bose-Einstein statistics **and the **theory of Bose-Einstein condensates,** which are now an important concept in modern physics.
 
• He was also a member of the **Royal Society of London** and was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan,** India's second-highest civilian award, in **1954. **
